purpose: This table is a small reference dimension mapping airline carrier IATA codes to their full legal airline names, intended to feed joins against flight-event or booking fact tables elsewhere in the warehouse.
usage: Consumers should join downstream fact tables to this table on the carrier code to resolve human-readable airline names; both columns are fully populated so no null-filtering is required before joining.
limitations: The dataset is very small (16 rows) and purely static reference data with no temporal or versioning columns, so carrier code reassignments or airline renames over time cannot be tracked from this table alone; pipeline capture metadata was dropped entirely as it carried no business value.
